## GPT-6.2 Sol Pro API

GPT-6.2 Sol Pro is a large language model by OpenAI, available on the Venice API as `openai-gpt-62-sol-pro`. The provider of this model may retain prompt data (though it is anonymized by Venice). For sensitive content, use a private model.

GPT-6.2 Sol with pro reasoning mode for difficult tasks that benefit from more model work. Supports text and image inputs with a 1.05M token context window. Pro mode can use more tokens and take longer than standard Sol.

### GPT-6.2 Sol Pro API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `openai-gpt-62-sol-pro` | Standard | Anonymized | $2.00 / $10.00 per 1M |

| Provider | OpenAI |

### How to use the GPT-6.2 Sol Pro API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses` with `"model": "openai-gpt-62-sol-pro"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "openai-gpt-62-sol-pro",
    "input": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences.",
    "reasoning": { "effort": "high" }
  }'
```
